To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
dextran-based nanoparticles can be obtained by the nanoprecipitation of dextran-drugs conjugates.

dextran derivatives with different degrees of substitution can be prepared via a straightforward one-pot reaction and that these dextran derivatives can self-assemble into stable nanoparticles with high loading efficiencies.
dextran derivatives can be used to prepare nanoparticles with high drug loading and good stability, which can be controlled via DS.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel drug delivery devices based on dextrin-drug conjugates and their application as nanoparticles for controlled drug delivery.
the preparation of dextran-based drug conjugates and the characterization of their nanoparticulate self-assembly.
a novel concept for a drug carrier system that combines the advantages of prodrug chemistry with those of nanoparticulate drug carriers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dextran-drugs conjugates are a promising platform for the development of drug delivery systems based on nanoparticles.
the dextran-ibuprofen and dextran-naproxen conjugates are suitable candidates for drug delivery applications, especially in the gastrointestinal tract.
the dextran-drugs conjugates represent promising candidates for drug delivery applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented concept allows the preparation of nanoparticles with high drug loadings and a defined pH-dependent drug release.
dextran-CDI-derivatives are promising candidates for the design of pH-sensitive drug delivery devices.
dextran-drugs conjugates can be used for the preparation of nanoparticles with a size of 100 to 300 nm and a size distribution of 5 to 15% (polydispersity index).
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of macromolecular drug carriers and nanoparticulate drug carriers may be a promising strategy to improve the pharmacological properties of poorly water-solubledrugs.
dextran derivatives with a defined DS value can be prepared and self-assemble into stable nanoparticles.
the presented approach allows for the preparation of nanoparticles based on water-soluble prodrugs.
